analysis.summary: [PERSON_1] reported by phone on 2026-11-02 three online card payments of £389.97 each to TechNova Online on 01/11 at 23:10, 23:12 and 23:15, totalling £1,169.91. He says he did not make them. His card ending [CARD_DIGITS_1] is still in his possession, and he says he shared no PIN, passcodes or one-time codes. The card was cancelled, a replacement was ordered and the online banking password was reset. By 2026-11-04 no refund had been credited, although FRD-1 expects one by the end of the next business day unless grounds for suspicion are recorded by Fraud & Scams. The customer has chased. He wants his £1,169.91 back.
